annotations.title: Compress a file from a URL

description: Download a file from a public URL, compress it on micompress.com and return a download link to the smaller file (valid 24 hours) with the size before and after. Works for images (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC, RAW…), PDF, video, audio, Office documents, EPUB and archives. Accepts direct links and Google Drive / Dropbox share links. Calls the MiCompress compression service; documentation: https://micompress.com/mcp-server

filename.description: Name to give the file, with extension (e.g. "report.pdf"). Only needed when the URL does not reveal the file type.

max_width.description: Images only: also resize down to this width in pixels.

preset.description: lossless keeps quality identical; recommended (default) balances size and quality; extreme gives the smallest file.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the file to compress.

name: compress_file_from_url
title: Compress a file from a URL
